The displayed formula has the wrong sign and evaluates the flow at the final point y rather than at the backward path.

A ReQU network generally has no continuous second derivatives, so the C^ell norm for ell >= 2 is not finite or even well-defined for the approximating network. The theorem therefore claims a simultaneous approximation result in norms beyond the regularity of the stated network class.
